name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task specifies that the agent may drop the key only after the door has been opened once. A hard `Absence(key_lost)` forbids the key from ever being dropped while the door is closed, even after the door has opened, which is too restrictive. Replace the second clause with a rule that prohibits `key_lost` until `door_open` occurs, e.g. `Precedence(door_open, key_lost)` (hard). This preserves the intended restriction while allowing the key to be dropped once the door is open.

texts: eventually pick up the target box
do not drop the key while the door is closed until it has been opened once
